actual.titulo: DP World Tour Golf • Amgen Irish Open, First Round
actual.descripcion: Amgen Irish Open, First Round | The Amgen Irish Open begins Round 1 at Trump International Golf Links in County Clare, Ireland. Competitors face a unique par-70 layout featuring five par-3s and five par-5s, starting with an opening hole surrounded by towering sand dunes.
